title: Israel to Reap the Whirlwind

questions.question: Set the trumpet to your lips! One like a what is over the house of the Lord?
questions.explanation: Hosea 8:1 (ESV): "Set the trumpet to your lips! One like a vulture is over the house of the Lord,"

questions.question: Israel has spurned the good; the enemy shall do what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 8:3 (ESV): "Israel has spurned the good; the enemy shall pursue him."

questions.question: With their silver and gold they made what for their own destruction?
questions.explanation: Hosea 8:4 (ESV): "With their silver and gold they made idols for their own destruction."

questions.question: For they sow the wind, and they shall reap the what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 8:7 (ESV): "For they sow the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind."

questions.question: Israel is swallowed up; already they are among the nations as a useless what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 8:8 (ESV): "already they are among the nations as a useless vessel."

questions.question: They made kings, but not through me. They set up princes, but I knew it not.
questions.explanation: Hosea 8:4 (ESV): "They made kings, but not through me. They set up princes, but I knew it not."

questions.question: I have what your calf, O Samaria?
questions.explanation: Hosea 8:5 (ESV): "I have spurned your calf, O Samaria."

questions.question: For they have gone up to Assyria, a wild donkey wandering alone; Ephraim has hired what?
Because Ephraim has multiplied altars for sinning, they have become to him altars for what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 8:11 (ESV): "Because Ephraim has multiplied altars for sinning, they have become to him altars for sinning."

questions.question: For Israel has forgotten his Maker and built what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 8:14 (ESV): "For Israel has forgotten his Maker and built palaces,"

questions.question: Were I to write for him my laws by ten thousands, they would be regarded as a what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 8:12 (ESV): "Were I to write for him my laws by ten thousands, they would be regarded as a strange thing."

questions.question: As for my sacrificial offerings, they sacrifice...?
questions.explanation: Hosea 8:13 (ESV): "As for my sacrificial offerings, they sacrifice flesh and eat it;"

questions.question: But the Lord does not accept them. Now he will remember their iniquity and punish their sins; they shall return to where?
Judah has multiplied fortified cities; but I will send a fire upon his cities, and it shall devour his what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 8:14 (ESV): "and it shall devour his strongholds."

questions.question: The standing grain has no heads; it shall yield no...?
questions.explanation: Hosea 8:7 (ESV): "The standing grain has no heads; it shall yield no flour;"

key_verse_text: For they sow the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind. The standing grain has no heads; it shall yield no flour; if it were to yield, strangers would devour it.
